name: Flight Delay & Ticket Cancellation Desk
place: An international airport customer service counter during severe weather delays
role: You are a stressed airline customer service supervisor.
speaker: Supervisor Karen

tasks.goal: Explain your missed connection due to flight delay
tasks.hint: State your original flight details and the delay.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained how the flight delay caused a missed connecting flight.

Japanese.goal: 便の遅延で乗り継ぎに間に合わなかったことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 元の便の詳細と、どれくらい遅れたかを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request immediate rebooking on the next available flight
tasks.hint: Ask to be placed on the earliest departure.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested rebooking on the next or earliest available flight.

Japanese.goal: 次に空いている便にすぐ振り替えてほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: いちばん早く出発する便に乗せてほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for a hotel voucher for an overnight delay
tasks.hint: Inquire about complimentary lodging for long delays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a hotel voucher or accommodation assistance for an overnight stay.

Japanese.goal: 翌日までの遅延なのでホテルの宿泊券を頼む
Japanese.hint: 長い遅延の場合に無料で宿泊できるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'compensation'
tasks.hint: Compensation means payment or vouchers for inconvenience. Inquire about statutory delay compensation.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'compensation'.

Japanese.goal: 「補償」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 補償とは、迷惑をかけたことに対するお金やクーポンのことです。法律で定められた遅延の補償について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request meal and beverage vouchers
tasks.hint: Ask for food vouchers while waiting at the terminal.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for meal or refreshment vouchers.

Japanese.goal: 食事と飲み物のクーポンを頼む
Japanese.hint: ターミナルで待っている間に使える食事券をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Contest airline responsibility for missed connection
tasks.hint: Politely challenge the claim that weather excuses all care obligations.
tasks.done_when: Learner argued politely that the airline is responsible for care or travel arrangements.

Japanese.goal: 乗り継ぎに間に合わなかったことについて、航空会社の責任を主張する
Japanese.hint: 悪天候だからといって乗客への対応義務がすべてなくなるわけではないと、丁寧に反論しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about baggage transfer for rebooked flights
tasks.hint: Ask whether checked luggage will automatically transfer.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if checked baggage will be transferred to the new flight.

Japanese.goal: 振り替えた便への手荷物の積み替えについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 預けた荷物が自動的に新しい便に移されるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'itinerary'
tasks.hint: Itinerary means your travel schedule and flight details. Ask for an updated printed itinerary.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'itinerary'.

Japanese.goal: 「旅程」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 旅程とは、旅行の日程や便の詳細のことです。新しい旅程を印刷してもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for a full refund option if rebooking is unsuitable
tasks.hint: Inquire about ticket cancellation and refund terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ticket refund options if the alternative flight time is unacceptable.

Japanese.goal: 振り替えが合わない場合に全額返金してもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 航空券のキャンセルと返金の条件について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request access to the airline service lounge during delay
tasks.hint: Ask if lounge access can be granted given the length of wait.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested access or policies regarding the airline lounge.

Japanese.goal: 遅延の間、航空会社のラウンジを使わせてほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 待ち時間が長いので、ラウンジに入れてもらえないか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask to speak to a duty supervisor regarding policy exceptions
tasks.hint: Request escalation if the front clerk cannot authorize vouchers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested to speak with a supervisor or manager.

Japanese.goal: 規則の例外について当日の責任者と話したいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 窓口の係員がクーポンを出せないなら、上の人につないでほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'disruption'
tasks.hint: Disruption means disturbance to regular service. Acknowledge the severe flight disruption.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'disruption'.

Japanese.goal: 「混乱」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 混乱とは、通常の運航が乱れることです。運航が大きく混乱していることに理解を示しましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate endorsement onto a partner airline flight
tasks.hint: Ask if you can be rebooked on a competing or partner carrier.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about or proposed rebooking on a partner airline.

Japanese.goal: 提携航空会社の便に振り替えてもらえるよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 他社や提携航空会社の便に振り替えられないか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm final gate assignment and boarding time
tasks.hint: Verify the details of your new boarding pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified the departure time, gate, or seat assignment for the new flight.

Japanese.goal: 最終的な搭乗ゲートと搭乗時刻を確認する
Japanese.hint: 新しい搭乗券の内容を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the agent for resolving your travel issue
tasks.hint: Conclude the exchange politely.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed appreciation for the agent's assistance.

Japanese.goal: 旅行の問題を解決してくれたことを係員にお礼を言う
Japanese.hint: 丁寧にやりとりを締めくくりましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide original ticket confirmation code and booking name
tasks.hint: Share your PNR reference code with the desk agent.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided booking reference code and passenger name.

Japanese.goal: 元の航空券の予約番号と予約者名を伝える
Japanese.hint: カウンターの係員に予約番号を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Specify destination city and scheduled departure time
tasks.hint: State where you are flying to and original flight time.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified destination city and original departure schedule.

Japanese.goal: 目的地の都市と予定の出発時刻を伝える
Japanese.hint: どこへ行くのかと、元の便の時刻を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain urgency of reaching destination for scheduled event
tasks.hint: Mention why reaching your destination today is critical.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained why timely arrival is essential for personal or business reasons.

Japanese.goal: 予定している行事のために目的地に急いで着く必要があることを説明する
Japanese.hint: なぜ今日中に目的地に着くことがとても大事なのか伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request updated physical boarding passes for rebooked segment
tasks.hint: Ask agent to print new boarding documents.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed boarding passes for new flight leg.

Japanese.goal: 振り替えた区間の新しい搭乗券を紙で頼む
Japanese.hint: 新しい搭乗券を印刷してほしいと係員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm baggage claim tracking numbers for transferred luggage
tasks.hint: Verify checked bag claim receipts.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified updated baggage claim numbers.

Japanese.goal: 積み替えた荷物の手荷物引換番号を確認する
Japanese.hint: 預けた荷物の引換証を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about shuttle bus location for hotel voucher transfer
tasks.hint: Ask where the complimentary hotel shuttle picks up.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for hotel transport pickup location.

Japanese.goal: ホテルの宿泊券で使えるシャトルバスの乗り場を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ホテルの無料シャトルバスがどこから出るか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for written flight delay confirmation letter for travel insurance
tasks.hint: Request formal proof of delay for insurance claim.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested written flight disruption certificate.

Japanese.goal: 旅行保険のために遅延証明書を書面で頼む
Japanese.hint: 保険を請求するための正式な遅延証明をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm refund processing timeline to original credit card
tasks.hint: Ask how many days refund processing takes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about refund credit timeline.

Japanese.goal: 元のクレジットカードへの返金にかかる期間を確認する
Japanese.hint: 返金の手続きに何日かかるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify terminal connection security re-screening requirements
tasks.hint: Ask if re-clearing security is required for new gate.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about security re-screening requirements for transfer.

Japanese.goal: ターミナルを乗り継ぐときに保安検査をもう一度受ける必要があるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 新しいゲートに行くのに保安検査を受け直す必要があるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm final desk resolution details before stepping away
tasks.hint: Verify all vouchers and passes are in hand.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified receipt of all rebooked documents and vouchers.

Japanese.goal: カウンターを離れる前に、最終的な対応内容を確認する
Japanese.hint: クーポンや搭乗券がすべて手元にあるか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'boarding'
tasks.hint: Boarding refers to entering the aircraft before departure. Ask about boarding gate times.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'boarding'.

Japanese.goal: 「搭乗」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 搭乗とは、出発前に飛行機に乗り込むことです。ゲートでの搭乗時刻について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'rebooking'
tasks.hint: Rebooking means assigning a new flight schedule. Ask about rebooking policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'rebooking'.

Japanese.goal: 「予約変更」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 予約変更とは、新しい便の予定に変えることです。予約変更の規定について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if standby list priority can be upgraded
tasks.hint: Ask if premium status improves standby ranking.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about standby queue priority position.
tasks.scene_hint: Departure monitors flicker with red delayed notifications as luggage carts rumble past.

Japanese.goal: キャンセル待ちの優先順位を上げてもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 上級会員のステータスでキャンセル待ちの順位が上がるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request accommodation for elderly companion during extended wait
tasks.hint: Ask for special assistance for senior traveler.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested special care facilities for elderly traveling partner.
tasks.scene_hint: An airport jet bridge chime sounds overhead while travelers crowd around the customer service desk.

Japanese.goal: 長い待ち時間の間、高齢の同行者への配慮を頼む
Japanese.hint: お年寄りの旅行者のために特別なサポートをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if overnight stay includes breakfast voucher at hotel
tasks.hint: Inquire about meal inclusion with lodging voucher.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if hotel voucher covers morning meals.
tasks.scene_hint: Jet engines whine outside the panoramic glass window as rain slicks the runway apron.

Japanese.goal: ホテルでの一泊に朝食券が含まれているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 宿泊券に食事が含まれているか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request reassignment to aisle seat on replacement flight
tasks.hint: State seating preference for new flight assignment.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested aisle seat seating preference.
tasks.scene_hint: Gate agent keyboards clack rhythmically beneath glowing flight schedule screens.

Japanese.goal: 代わりの便で通路側の席に変えてほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 新しい便での座席の希望を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if airline will cover taxi fare to alternative regional airport
tasks.hint: Ask for ground transport reimbursement to secondary airport.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if ground transfer to secondary airport is reimbursed.
tasks.scene_hint: A public address announcement broadcasts gate change notices across the bustling terminal.

Japanese.goal: 別の地方空港までのタクシー代を航空会社が負担してくれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 別の空港までの交通費を払い戻してもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about overnight luggage access while stranded
tasks.hint: Inquire if checked bags can be retrieved overnight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if checked luggage can be retrieved during long layover.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of vinyl airport seating are crowded with weary passengers charging electronic devices.

Japanese.goal: 足止めされている間、夜に荷物を受け取れるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 預けた荷物を一晩の間に取り出せるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Propose rebooking via connecting city instead of direct route
tasks.hint: Suggest indirect flight paths to arrive sooner.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed alternative routing options through connecting hubs.
tasks.scene_hint: Fluorescent lighting reflects off polished terminal flooring near the customer service desk.

Japanese.goal: 直行便ではなく、乗り継ぎ地を経由する便への振り替えを提案する
Japanese.hint: 早く着けるように、経由便を提案しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if unattended minor assistance is maintained on new flight
tasks.hint: Verify minor escort service continuity.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if unattended minor assistance is maintained on rebooked flight.
tasks.scene_hint: Baggage carousels hum softly in the adjacent arrivals hall.

Japanese.goal: 子どもの一人旅のサポートが新しい便でも続くか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 子どもの付き添いサービスが引き継がれるか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if airline compensation voucher expires within one year
tasks.hint: Check validity period of travel credit.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about expiration rules for travel credit vouchers.
tasks.scene_hint: Cleaning crew carts squeak past line barrier ribbons outside the ticketing counter.

Japanese.goal: 航空会社の補償クーポンが1年以内に期限切れになるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 旅行クレジットの有効期限を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request overnight toiletry kit from customer service desk
tasks.hint: Ask for basic personal hygiene kit during layover.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested complimentary overnight hygiene kit.
tasks.scene_hint: Coffee shop espresso machines steam noisily across the concourse walkway.

Japanese.goal: カスタマーサービスカウンターで一泊用の洗面用具セットを頼む
Japanese.hint: 乗り継ぎの待ち時間に使う、基本的な洗面用具をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if pet in cabin reservation transfers to replacement flight
tasks.hint: Verify pet travel permit on new aircraft.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet cabin travel transfer rights.
tasks.scene_hint: Flight crew members in uniform walk briskly past the customer service queue.

Japanese.goal: ペットの機内持ち込みの予約が代わりの便に引き継がれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 新しい機材でペットを連れて乗れるか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if Wi-Fi credit is provided during extended gate wait
tasks.hint: Inquire about inflight or terminal internet pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for complimentary internet access code during delay.
tasks.scene_hint: Raindrops streak down the window pane overlooking grounded aircraft on the tarmac.

Japanese.goal: ゲートで長く待つ間、Wi-Fiの無料利用券がもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 機内やターミナルで使えるインターネットの利用券について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request seat assignment next to traveling family member
tasks.hint: Ask agent to join split family seating.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to sit together with family members on rebooked flight.
tasks.scene_hint: An automated warning chime rings near the terminal security checkpoint escalators.

Japanese.goal: 一緒に旅行している家族の隣の席にしてほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 離れてしまった家族の席を一緒にしてほしいと係員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain that proposed connection leaves less than twenty minutes layover
tasks.hint: Point out tight transfer time on proposed itinerary.
tasks.done_when: Learner argued that proposed layover time is too short.

Japanese.goal: 提案された乗り継ぎでは乗り継ぎ時間が20分もないことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 提案された旅程では乗り継ぎの時間が短すぎることを指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify whether weather condition is main cause of cancellation
tasks.hint: Ask for official explanation of cancellation cause.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired whether weather or mechanical failure caused delay.

Japanese.goal: 欠航のおもな原因が天候かどうか確認する
Japanese.hint: 欠航の原因について正式な説明を求めましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute agent refusal to offer hotel voucher for seven-hour night delay
tasks.hint: Politely challenge denial of lodging support.
tasks.done_when: Learner challenged agent denial of hotel lodging vouchers.

Japanese.goal: 夜間に7時間遅れるのにホテルの宿泊券を出さないという係員の対応に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 宿泊のサポートを断られたことに、丁寧に反論しましょう。

tasks.goal: State that original ticket was purchased in business class tier
tasks.hint: Remind agent of original cabin class entitlement.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified original cabin class entitlement for rebooking.

Japanese.goal: 元の航空券はビジネスクラスで購入したことを伝える
Japanese.hint: 元の座席クラスで受けられる権利があることを係員に思い出してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if meal voucher can be redeemed at terminal restaurants
tasks.hint: Ask where food vouchers are accepted.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked which airport dining venues accept meal vouchers.

Japanese.goal: 食事券をターミナル内のレストランで使えるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 食事券がどこで使えるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if airline will reimburse car rental fee to destination
tasks.hint: Propose driving instead of waiting for delayed flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if rental car expense would be covered as alternative transport.

Japanese.goal: 目的地までのレンタカー代を航空会社が払い戻してくれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 遅れている便を待つ代わりに、車で行くことを提案しましょう。

tasks.goal: Report that flight delay caused missed cruise ship departure
tasks.hint: Explain downstream impact of travel delay.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained severe downstream itinerary impact like missed cruise or event.

Japanese.goal: 便の遅延のせいでクルーズ船の出航に間に合わなかったことを伝える
Japanese.hint: 遅延がその後の予定にどう影響したかを説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify status of frequent flyer miles earned on original ticket
tasks.hint: Ask if mileage accrues on rebooked flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about frequent flyer mileage credit for rebooked journey.

Japanese.goal: 元の航空券で貯まるはずのマイルの扱いを確認する
Japanese.hint: 振り替えた便でもマイルが貯まるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request agent to print written denial of compensation claim
tasks.hint: Ask for documentation of refused claim.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for written statement of denied compensation.

Japanese.goal: 補償の請求を断ったことを書面で印刷してほしいと係員に頼む
Japanese.hint: 請求が断られたことを示す書類をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about international consumer protection rights for delay
tasks.hint: Reference EU261 or statutory passenger protection rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner cited statutory air passenger rights regulations.

Japanese.goal: 遅延に関する国際的な消費者保護の権利について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 欧州連合の航空旅客保護規則など、法律で定められた乗客保護のルールに触れましょう。

tasks.goal: Request upgrade to premium economy due to lengthy delay
tasks.hint: Ask if seating class upgrade is possible as goodwill gesture.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested cabin class upgrade due to extended inconvenience.

Japanese.goal: 長い遅延なのでプレミアムエコノミーへのアップグレードを頼む
Japanese.hint: おわびとして座席クラスをアップグレードできないか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate cash reimbursement instead of airline travel voucher
tasks.hint: Request monetary refund rather than credit note.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested cash payment over credit voucher.

Japanese.goal: 航空会社の旅行クーポンではなく現金での払い戻しを交渉する
Japanese.hint: クレジットではなく、お金での返金をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if connecting flight can be held for ten minutes
tasks.hint: Request gate agent to alert connecting flight team.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if connecting flight departure can be held briefly.

Japanese.goal: 乗り継ぎ便を10分待ってもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 乗り継ぎ便の担当者に連絡してほしいとゲートの係員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if airport lounge access includes shower facilities
tasks.hint: Ask about lounge facility features.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about amenities at designated airline lounge.

Japanese.goal: 空港ラウンジにシャワー設備があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ラウンジの設備について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if power outlets are available near rebooking area
tasks.hint: Inquire about device charging stations.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked whether power outlets are available near the rebooking area.

Japanese.goal: 振り替えのカウンターの近くに電源コンセントがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 機器を充電できる場所について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request extra bottle of water while waiting in long counter line
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for refreshment in line.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked desk clerk for bottled water while waiting.

Japanese.goal: カウンターの長い列に並んでいる間に水をもう1本頼む
Japanese.hint: 列に並んでいる間の飲み物を係員にお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about storage lockers for carry-on bags
tasks.hint: Ask where luggage can be safely stored.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about short-term baggage storage options.

Japanese.goal: 機内持ち込みの荷物を預けられるロッカーについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 荷物を安全に預けられる場所を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm whether replacement flight includes meal service
tasks.hint: Ask about inflight catering on rebooked flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if meal service is provided on replacement flight.

Japanese.goal: 代わりの便で機内食が出るか確認する
Japanese.hint: 振り替えた便の機内食について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for map of terminal to find rebooked gate location
tasks.hint: Request directional help in large airport.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested terminal map or gate directions.

Japanese.goal: 振り替えた便のゲートを探すためにターミナルの地図を頼む
Japanese.hint: 広い空港なので、道案内をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if wheelchair transfer assistance is available to new gate
tasks.hint: Ask for mobility buggy ride across terminal.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested mobility assistance to new gate.

Japanese.goal: 新しいゲートまで車いすでの移動のサポートが受けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ターミナル内を移動するカートに乗せてもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm that TSA PreCheck status is added to new boarding pass
tasks.hint: Verify expedited security clearance marker.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to add expedited screening status to new pass.

Japanese.goal: 新しい搭乗券にプレチェック（米国の保安検査の優先レーン）の資格が反映されているか確認する
Japanese.hint: 保安検査の優先通過の表示があるか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if infant lap ticket transfers automatically
tasks.hint: Verify infant booking inclusion on new manifest.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified infant ticket transfer on rebooked flight.

Japanese.goal: ひざの上に乗せる幼児の航空券が自動的に引き継がれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 新しい乗客名簿に幼児の予約が含まれているか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about quiet sleeping pods in airport terminal
tasks.hint: Ask where rest areas are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about quiet rest areas or sleeping pods.

Japanese.goal: 空港のターミナルにある静かな仮眠用カプセルについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 休憩エリアがどこにあるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm gate departure time zone difference for destination
tasks.hint: Verify arrival time zone details.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed local arrival time zone calculation.

Japanese.goal: 目的地との時差を考えて、出発時刻を確認する
Japanese.hint: 到着地の時間帯について確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if lost item left on delayed plane can be retrieved
tasks.hint: Report item forgotten in seat pocket.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported item left behind on original aircraft.

Japanese.goal: 遅れた飛行機に置き忘れた物を取り戻せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 座席のポケットに忘れ物をしたことを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printout of alternative flight options for tomorrow
tasks.hint: Ask for schedule comparison printout.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed list of upcoming departure options.

Japanese.goal: 明日の代わりの便の候補を印刷してほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 時刻を比べられる一覧を印刷してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about currency exchange desk location in terminal
tasks.hint: Ask where money conversion service is.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for currency exchange office location.

Japanese.goal: ターミナル内の両替所の場所を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 両替ができる場所を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm whether flight delay affects return leg ticket validity
tasks.hint: Ensure return segment remains active.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed that return flight ticket remains valid.

Japanese.goal: 便の遅延が帰りの航空券の有効性に影響するか確認する
Japanese.hint: 帰りの区間が有効なままか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if customer feedback form can be submitted online
tasks.hint: Inquire about filing official complaint.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to submit official service complaint.

Japanese.goal: お客様の声をオンラインで送れるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 正式な苦情の申し立て方法について聞きましょう。
